import os
from typing import List

from openai import OpenAI


def embed_text(text: str) -> List[float]:
    client = OpenAI(api_key=os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY"))
    response = client.embeddings.create(model="text-embedding-3-small", input=text)

+import os

+from typing import Any, Optional
+
+from openai import OpenAI
+
+
+DEFAULT_EMBEDDING_MODEL = "text-embedding-3-small"
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class EmbeddingsConfig:
+    api_key: Optional[str] = None
+    base_url: Optional[str] = None
+    organization: Optional[str] = None
+    project: Optional[str] = None
+    model: str = DEFAULT_EMBEDDING_MODEL
+
+
+def load_config() -> EmbeddingsConfig:
+    return EmbeddingsConfig(
+        api_key=os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY"),
+        base_url=os.environ.get("OPENAI_BASE_URL"),
+        organization=os.environ.get("OPENAI_ORG_ID"),
+        project=os.environ.get("OPENAI_PROJECT_ID"),
+        model=os.environ.get("OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL", DEFAULT_EMBEDDING_MODEL),
+    )
+
+
+def create_client(config: Optional[EmbeddingsConfig] = None) -> OpenAI:
+    cfg = config or load_config()
+    kwargs: dict[str, Any] = {}
+    if cfg.api_key:
+        kwargs["api_key"] = cfg.api_key
+    if cfg.base_url:
+        kwargs["base_url"] = cfg.base_url
+    if cfg.organization:
+        kwargs["organization"] = cfg.organization
+    if cfg.project:
+        kwargs["project"] = cfg.project
+    return OpenAI(**kwargs)
+
+
+def get_embedding_model(config: Optional[EmbeddingsConfig] = None) -> str:
+    return (config or load_config()).model

+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
+
+from openai import OpenAI
+
+
+def _get_client() -> OpenAI:
+    return OpenAI(api_key=os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY"))
+
+
+def _get_model() -> str:
+    return os.environ.get("OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL", "text-embedding-3-small")
+
+
+def embed_for_search(query: str, documents: List[str], normalize: bool = True) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    client = _get_client()
+    model = _get_model()
+    inputs = [query] + documents
+    response = client.embeddings.create(model=model, input=inputs)
+    vectors = [item.embedding for item in response.data]
+    if normalize:
+        vectors = [_normalize(vec) for vec in vectors]
+    return {"query_embedding": vectors[0], "document_embeddings": vectors[1:], "model": model}
+
+
+def _normalize(vector: List[float]) -> List[float]:
+    norm = sum(x * x for x in vector) ** 0.5
+    if not norm:
+        return vector
+    return [x / norm for x in vector]
*** End Patch
